parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Paging starts from page 1.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Paging is performed based on this value.

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryUid
parameters.description: The UID of the resource directory.
